episodes.title: Aflevering 1
episodes.summary: To his girlfriend's surprise, Roman quits his job at the call center as soon as he is hired by the local police wiretapping unit.

episodes.title: Aflevering 2
episodes.summary: After an attack in a Rotterdam restaurant, Roman helps expose a notorious crime gang: the Uzbek Beatles. But now his own life is at stake.

episodes.title: Aflevering 3
episodes.summary: A witness under police protection is murdered, and Roman loses his loyal companion. Concerned for the safety of his family, he turns to Nico.

episodes.title: Aflevering 4
episodes.summary: Roman makes costly mistakes when he is under intense pressure to find the criminals responsible for a young girl's blindness.

episodes.title: Aflevering 5
episodes.summary: After Roman's drunken confession, Caro struggles with their relationship and asks him to distance himself. Overwhelmed by grief, he faces difficult choices.

episodes.title: Aflevering 6
episodes.summary: Roman struggles with his newfound awareness of fatherhood. Yet he finds the courage to do the right thing, even if it means facing danger himself.
